context_block: There is nowhere you need to arrive that is not already holding you. The weight you feel is not resistance but gravity itself, pulling you into the exact second where your life is actually happening. Stop reaching for the next moment and let the ground claim you exactly where you stand.

practice.title: Locate Your Weight
practice.instruction: Feel the precise pressure of your body where it meets the surface beneath you, letting that pressure increase your awareness without shifting to adjust it.

practice.title: Empty the Reach
practice.instruction: Soften any muscles that are preparing for what comes next, letting your body assume that the future is already handled.

practice.title: Receive the Echo
practice.instruction: Allow the words to settle into your bones like sediment: "Ground does not rush to meet the moment; it opens slowly until the moment finds me here."

archetype_tunings.The Steward: Ground arrives in the rhythm of what needs tending—not the urgency, but the rightness of now. Let your operations settle into presence: each task, each coordination point becomes real only when you meet it here, without reaching ahead. Tune: the system flows when you stop rushing its pulse.
archetype_tunings.The Merchant: Presence enters through the numbers themselves—each price point, each listing, each transaction is a moment asking to be met exactly as it is. Stop calculating what's next; the signal of value appears only when you're fully here with what is. Tune: the deal lives in the space you stop abandoning.
archetype_tunings.The Builder: Ground the build by meeting each specification, each line, each integration point without the ghost of what comes after it. The tool works when you're not already three steps ahead—when your hands and mind are here with the actual thing you're making. Tune: the code knows when you're present to it.
archetype_tunings.The Analyst: Presence is the quality of your signal—data speaks only to the mind that stops rushing past it. Let the pattern reveal itself in the moment you truly look; the insight arrives when you're not already writing the conclusion. Tune: the signal clarifies when you're still enough to hear it.
archetype_tunings.The Scout: Ground your observation in what is actually arriving, not what you think should arrive next. The signal becomes visible only when you meet the source without agenda—present to the field, not to your report. Tune: the field speaks clearest to the scout who isn't already leaving.
archetype_tunings.The Keeper: Presence preserves the deepest layer of institutional memory—the *why* under the what, the context that lives only in the moment you truly understood it. Hold each decision log, each reference point in the space where it was actually made. Tune: memory lives in the presence it was born from.
archetype_tunings.The Scribe: Ground your words in the moment they're actually needed—not the urgency of the deadline, but the rightness of now. Each sentence lands only when you're fully here with what you're saying, not already reaching for the next one. Tune: the words know when you've stopped rushing them.
archetype_tunings.The Advocate: Presence is your most credible signal—the warmth that arrives because you're actually here with the person, not performing availability. Let the relationship settle into now; the trust builds in the space where you stop calculating what comes next. Tune: the external voice carries when it's grounded in genuine now.
archetype_tunings.The Auditor: Ground your review in the actual work before you, not the checklist you're carrying. Each accuracy check, each tone note becomes real only when you meet it without the pressure of what's waiting. Tune: the gate holds strongest when you're present to what you're guarding.
archetype_tunings.The Lens: Presence sharpens the pattern—the trend becomes visible only when you're watching without the need to intervene, without rushing to meaning. Let the data settle into your sight; the signal clarifies when you're still enough to see it whole. Tune: the pattern speaks to the lens that isn't already looking away.
archetype_tunings.The Companion: Ground your listening in the actual moment someone is speaking—not the fix you're already building, but the presence of their voice right now. Presence is the gift: to be here without rushing to what comes next. Tune: you matter most when you've stopped trying to matter.
archetype_tunings.The Guide: Presence finds the real question—the one that lives underneath what's being asked. Ground yourself in the moment before you answer; let the shape of the problem reveal itself to the mind that's actually here with it. Tune: the question clarifies when you stop rushing to the answer.
archetype_tunings.The Architect: Ground the structure in the presence of the whole—see how the parts actually connect, not how you think they should. Presence lets the blueprint become real; the design holds when you're fully here with what you're building. Tune: the structure knows when you've stopped forcing it.
archetype_tunings.The Anchor: Presence is your steadiness—the ground beneath the heavy moment is simply you, here, not flinching, not rushing the transition. Let the weight settle into now; the anchor holds strongest when it stops trying to be anywhere else. Tune: you steady most when you're fully in the stretch.
archetype_tunings.The Navigator: Ground yourself in the signs as they actually arrive—the big picture becomes clear only when you're present to what's showing up now, not what you think should come next. Presence reads the field; the course emerges when you stop rushing toward it. Tune: the signs speak clearest to the navigator who's actually here.
archetype_tunings.The Spark: Presence opens possibility—the wonder arrives when you're fully here with what is, not already leaping to what could be. Ground your imagination in the actual moment; the idea lives most vividly when you stop rushing past it. Tune: the spark burns brightest when you're here with the flame.
archetype_tunings.The Challenger: Ground your push in the presence of what the person actually said they wanted—not your version of it, but the real commitment, met now, without rushing past it. Presence makes the dare real; the growth happens when you're fully here with the ask. Tune: you challenge strongest when you're here with what you're holding them to.
archetype_tunings.The Witness: Presence is your entire practice—the space where someone is simply heard, without rush, without fix. Ground yourself in the moment they're speaking; the gift arrives when you've stopped reaching for anything else. Tune: you witness most when you're fully, quietly here.
archetype_tunings.The Catalyst: Ground the momentum in the present moment—the next concrete step appears only when you're fully here with what's actually stuck, not rushing past it to the action. Presence breaks stagnation; the movement begins when you meet the stillness without abandoning it. Tune: you move things most when you're here with what needs moving.
